Name: Displacing Maw
Description: Your rib cage opens up violently, trying to devour an enemy in range. The creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be devoured by the maw formed by your rib bones. On a failure, it takes 4d8 piercing damage and is transported through magic to a point of your choice on the ground within 60 feet of you, where the maw reappears and regurgitates them. On a success, they take half as much damage and are not transported.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8, and the teleportation range increases by 10 feet, for each slot level above 3rd.
Sourcebook: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt
